convert_chmv2_checkpoint: convert a CHMv2 checkpoint to HuggingFace format with optional backbone and verification
create_chmv2_config: create a CHMv2Config with DINOv3 backbone and depth estimation parameters
convert_head_keys: convert CHMv2 head state dict keys to HuggingFace naming convention via regex mapping
convert_backbone_keys: convert DINOv3 backbone state dict keys to HuggingFace format with qkv splitting
load_original_state_dict: load a PyTorch checkpoint handling model or state_dict wrapper keys
